Produce a crisp high-resolution transparent PNG of EXACTLY the same pixel face, no head silhouette, no text, no T-shirt mockup. Preserve the pixel-grid construction, the positions and relative sizes of both eyebrows, both black eyes, all grayscale highlight blocks, and the small W-shaped pixel mouth. Square hard pixel edges, no blur, no rounded corners, no anti-aliased cartoon redraw, no added eyelashes or cheeks. Remove only the white outer background; the two small white square eye highlights should remain opaque white. Keep substantial original blank space around the face within a square canvas. Both eyes identical in size, each has the same left-side white square highlight and lower-right dark/medium gray stepped reflections as the reference. All pixel blocks must align on one square grid. Restore detail by crisp geometric edges, not invented extra pixels. Highest available resolution.
